comparator.name: Theatre Studies (Theaterwetenschap)
comparator.academicYear: Current published UvA bachelor curriculum, checked 2026-09-28
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme table reconstructs a complete 180-EC full-time bachelor: 60 EC in each of three years. Year 1 establishes Theatre Studies concepts and methods through dramaturgy, European and global performance history, academic skills, arts/culture/society and a 12-EC performance-analysis course. Year 2 develops theatre-text analysis, translation from text to performance, philosophy of science, Dutch theatre history in European context and a study trip, with one 6-EC programme-restricted choice and 6 EC of free choice. Year 3 combines one further 6-EC programme-restricted choice, Performing Ecocriticism, 36 EC of free choice and a 12-EC thesis. The published explanation identifies 54 EC of total choice space (12 EC programme-restricted and 42 EC free choice); those formal choice components are preserved without inventing selections. Although the overview mentions a possible internship within the graduation trajectory, the detailed curriculum states that an internship is not compulsory, so none is inserted.

exception.reason: The defining curriculum requires substantial staged study in dramaturgy, theatre and performance history, Theatre Studies theory and methods, live-performance analysis, theatre-text analysis, the movement from text to performance, Dutch theatre history, performance philosophy and an independent Theatre Studies thesis. Even allowing all 42 EC of genuine free choice and both 6-EC restricted choices, the current UCR catalogue has no Theatre Studies course, no dramaturgy course, no theatre-history sequence and no live-performance-analysis sequence. A 24-course programme assembled from literature, media, communication, art history and cultural studies would replace the discipline with adjacent fields rather than provide a defensible closest UCR match.
exception.curriculumContext: The published full-time curriculum totals exactly 180 EC: 60 EC in year one, 60 EC in year two and 60 EC in year three. It contains 126 EC of named compulsory Theatre Studies and related components, 12 EC of programme-restricted choice and 42 EC of genuine free choice. The restricted and free-choice spaces are preserved generically, and the optional internship is not treated as compulsory.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 rows of the current enriched UCR course workbook, including course names, descriptions, outline-derived profiles, prerequisites, planned availability, disciplines, topics and methods. MCCLITR111 Introduction to Literary Studies includes drama as one literary genre; MCCLITR112 Great Literary Works discusses texts that have influenced theatre; MCCLITR211 World Myth & Literature briefly considers storytelling in theatrical performance; MCCLITR311 Film & Text analyses film adaptation, including acting; MCCCOMM312 Creative Communication Laboratory includes poetry and performance as creative communication; and media, art-history, rhetoric and cultural-studies courses supply broader interpretive contexts. These are adjacent fragments. None provides dramaturgy, Theatre Studies concepts and methods, theatre or performance history, sustained analysis of live performance, theatre-text-to-production study or a Theatre Studies research progression. The workbook therefore provides no defensible basis for a scheduled 24-course UCR Theatre Studies programme.
